status: Editorial recommendations only. No vocabulary, policy, boards or prior approvals changed.
scope: Screened the 2,318 approved required spellings, the 118 eligible bonus-only spellings, and the 500 active boards. Detailed new source checks focus on the shortlisted words, not all 2,436 spellings.
limitations: Dictionary evidence establishes meanings and some register/spelling distinctions. It does not measure player familiarity.
Removal priorities are assistant editorial judgments for a broad casual audience, not native-speaker review, corpus frequency measurements or player-test results.
A second look at an existing approval is not a withdrawal of that approval.
Valid unfamiliar words should generally leave the compulsory pool while remaining optional bonuses.
No proposed replacement wheel, board or campaign has been generated or validated.
